data.title: The sentence crossed out in blue
data.goal: The sentence crossed out in blue

memoryNodes.cue: Nora crosses out a long sentence.

data.situation:
Nora drew a blue line through a rather long sentence. She asked Jo to paraphrase it without losing the date or the location. The new version was concise, and a succinct heading helped readers find it quickly. Jo was not sure of the extent of the change: had the room moved, or only the entrance? They checked the map before making an amendment. Nora did not ignore Jo’s question. It would have been easy to overlook the difference while shortening the text. They kept a small copy of the old paragraph beside the new one. Fewer words were useful only if the words left on the page still led people to the right place. Jo: To what extent has the route changed?
Nora: Only the entrance has moved.
Jo: Then I will paraphrase the sentence and make that clear.

readingBlocks.zh: 诺拉用蓝笔划掉一句相当长的话，请乔换一种说法，保留日期和地点。新版更简洁，一个简明标题也让读者容易找到它。乔不确定变化的范围：是房间换了，还是只有入口换了？她们先查看地图，再修改。诺拉没有忽视这个问题；缩短文章时，很容易漏掉这一差别。旧段落的小副本留在新段落旁。减少文字有用，前提是剩下的话仍能把人引到正确的地方。

乔：路线变化到什么程度？
诺拉：只有入口换了。
乔：那我换个说法，把它讲清楚。

glossary.zh: 保持意思而换一种说法
glossary.note: paraphrase something；不同措辞应保留原意。
glossary.exampleZh: 乔把长句换一种说法写出。

externalEvidence.definition: express the same message in different words

glossary.note: concise 不只是短，也要表达清楚。
a succinct summary；与 concise 相近，分别用于标题和正文。

externalEvidence.definition: briefly giving the gist of something

glossary.zh: 某事达到的程度或范围
glossary.note: the extent of；to what extent 表示到何种程度。
glossary.example: Jo checked the extent of the change.

externalEvidence.definition: the point or degree to which something extends

glossary.zh: 对文字等作的小幅修改
glossary.example: Nora made an amendment to the draft.

externalEvidence.definition: a statement that is added to or revises or improves a proposal or document (a bill or constitution etc.)

glossary.note: ignore something；通常带有不予理会的意味。
glossary.example: Nora did not ignore the question.

externalEvidence.definition: give little or no attention to

glossary.note: 这里是漏看；也可表示俯瞰。
glossary.example: Jo nearly overlooked the changed entrance.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔差点漏看入口的变化。

glossary.note: rather + 形容词；与 rather than 的结构不同。
glossary.example: The first sentence was rather long.
